topic: the pricing model for the new analytics add-on

options.A: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

versions.option_text: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Henrik
chain.gist: Henrik proposes charging per seat for the analytics add-on, at $12 per seat per month.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Henrik
chain.gist: Henrik says per-seat pricing is predictable for buyers and scales with how many people use the dashboards, unlike the usage-based plan that confused beta customers.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Diego
chain.gist: Diego decides to go with per-seat pricing at $12 for launch.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Sven
chain.gist: Sven reports that three of the five pilot accounts have teams over 40 people, so a typical add-on bill would exceed $480 a month, and two accounts told the customer success manager that felt steep.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Ingrid
chain.gist: Ingrid argues that big teams will balk at a bill that grows with every hire, and that a flat or tiered price would avoid losing the largest accounts.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Diego
chain.gist: Diego says the pilot team sizes and Ingrid's concern deserve a proper second look at the per-seat decision.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Henrik
chain.gist: Henrik answers that the three large accounts have negotiated enterprise discounts, the two that called it steep are free-trial accounts that never paid, and competitors charge $15 to $20 per seat so $12 leaves room.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month

chain.speaker: Diego
chain.gist: Diego confirms the team is keeping per-seat pricing at $12 for launch.
chain.option: Per-seat pricing at $12 per seat per month
